description: This file defines the APIException class, a custom runtime exception used within the OpenMRS API infrastructure to handle fatal or critical errors that occur within the system API layer.

classes.name: APIException
classes.description: A runtime exception class used to represent fatal errors in the OpenMRS API layer, with various constructors for different error reporting scenarios.

methods.name: APIException()
methods.description: Default constructor, not recommended for general use.

methods.name: APIException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a helpful message string related to the error.

methods.name: APIException(String message, Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a message and a cause Throwable to be wrapped.

methods.name: APIException(Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor that chains a parent cause Throwable.

methods.name: APIException(String messageKey, Object[] parameters)
methods.description: Constructor that retrieves a message via Context.getMessageSourceService() using message key and parameters.

methods.name: APIException(String messageKey, Object[] parameters, Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor that retrieves a localized message and chains a cause Throwable.
